headline: Make Collectors Prove Before You Pay
description: Free case review. Flat monthly fee.
primary_text:
Getting collection calls about a debt you're not sure you owe?

Before you pay a cent, you can make the collector validate the debt in writing. Many collectors, especially debt buyers, can't produce the paperwork to back it up.

Our attorneys review what they send and tell you where you stand.
